summary: Table of invoices and billing transactions supplied by the caller.
whenToUse: Showing an invoice history in an account area.
whenNotToUse: Generating invoices or performing downloads on its own.
accessibility: HTML table with column and row headers.
responsive: The table scrolls horizontally in narrow containers.
customization: Uses Button for actions and --dc-* tokens for the table.
commonMistakes: Expecting the action to download or request an invoice without a consumer callback.
limits: Does not fetch invoices or start downloads.
